name: Lust Age
source:
You're a normal guy living a normal life (boring!), you have a perverted friend (that sounds good!), but fate has something very special for you... Become the new Champion of Gold Valley, a place inhabited and ruled exclusively by women who want to meet the new champion Aspirant... You! Earn the trust of the people and make them all fall in love with you!

[From [url=https://keisi-studio.itch.io/lust-age-nsfw-by-keisi/devlog/397537/game-overview]Itch.io[/url]]
